applicationMap.webglNotSupported:
The Instana user interface contains 3D components that are rendered using a technology called WebGL. Unfortunately this technology is not yet available on all platforms. Some browsers, especially browsers in older versions, do not support WebGL. We recommend using the newest generation of auto-updating browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari 8 or MS Edge.

We try our best to support all platform and browser combinations. However, it may be that our usage of WebGL contains errors. You can use an [online test](https://get.webgl.org/) to check whether your platform supports WebGL.

Should the online test state that your platform supports WebGL, but the Instana 3D Map still remains inoperable, [please contact us](https://support.instana.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).

For further troubleshooting information please refer to the [WebGL compatibility table](http://caniuse.com/#feat=webgl) or the [WebGL website](http://webgl.org/).
applicationMap.webglNotInitialized:
You browser supports WebGL, but it can't be initialized. This can happen for some browser and hardware reasons. Some possible reasons are:

  - too many open tabs
  - lack of a dedicated GPU or a busy GPU
  - browser / hardware incompatibility

For further troubleshooting information please refer to the [WebGL test site](https://get.webgl.org/) or the [official WebGL documentation](https://www.khronos.org/webgl/wiki/FAQ).

servicesEndpoints.name: Services or Endpoints
servicesEndpoints.headline: A collection of services or endpoints
servicesEndpoints.whenToUse: If the services or endpoints are well known and the group won’t change soon. This is often an application that a specific team is responsible for, or which provides a single function (eg. Payment Application). This is the simplest approach.
servicesEndpoints.whoShouldUse: DevOps, Operations, SRE, Developer, QA, Support, Business owner.

whenToUse.userJourneyDescribes: A critical user journey describes a set of interactions a user has with a service to achieve some end result.
whenToUse.otherTerms: Other terms for a user journey are business use case or business transaction. Identifying user journeys are the first step in using Instana’s SLI/SLO. So select the service or endpoints that form the critical user journey to monitor.

tipsForUsingItems.sourcePerspective: Use "No downstream services" and "Inbound calls" for the source's perspective.
tipsForUsingItems.endToEndView: Use "All downstream services" and  "All calls" for the end-to-end view.
tipsForUsingItems.directServices: Use "Immediate downstream services" to include the direct database or messaging services.
tipsForUsingItems.useOperatorsServices: Use string operators (e.g., like "contains", "starts with") to select several services with one filter.
tipsForUsingItems.useOperatorsEndpoints: Use string operators (e.g., like "contains", "starts with") to select several endpoints with one filter.
tipsForUsingItems.useOperators: Use string operators (e.g., like "contains", "starts with") to simplify the filter.
tipsForUsingItems.narrowScope: Add setup, environment, or custom tags to narrow the scope.
tipsForUsingItems.specifyAp: Use either request parameters or custom tags to specify the AP.
tipsForUsingItems.preselected: The "Inbound calls" and  "All downstream services" are preselected.
tipsForUsingItems.switchMode: Switch to Advanced Mode to create a query with endpoints from multiple services.
tipsForUsingItems.allFilters: Click on "All Filters" to add additional tags.

advanced.defineName: Define a name for your Application Perspective.
advanced.apNameDescription: Application Perspective names should have a well established definition within an organization. For example, to model an environment: "Production Blue", to model a set of services: "Payment", or to model a tenant: "ACME Customer".
advanced.defineUsingTags: Define the Application Perspective using one or more tags.
advanced.defineUsingTagsDescription: For example where key is "docker.label" and value is "environment=Production Blue", or key is "call.http.params" and value is "tenant=ACMECustomer". Note that any calls to a <pill-database>DATABASE</pill-database> service or <pill-messaging>MESSAGING</pill-messaging> service from services matching this definition will automatically be included.
advanced.andOperatorsPrecedence: AND operators take precedence and are evaluated before OR operators
advanced.andOperatorsPrecedenceBrackets: AND operators take precedence and are evaluated before OR operators if not grouped in brackets
advanced.downstreamCallsDescription: Choose which downstream services to include in the Application Perspective.
